name: combobox
title: Combobox
description: Filterable text field with an option list, optional async loading, and custom values.

api.description: Filterable text field backed by Option List. Supports static options, async loading, clear, and optional custom values.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled committed option value. The input shows the matching label; typing uses a separate query string.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial option value.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the option value when a selection is committed, or with custom text when allowCustomValue is set.

props.name: options
props.description: Static options to filter.

props.name: loadOptions
props.description: Async option loader for the current query.

props.name: allowCustomValue
props.description: Allow committing text that is not in the option list.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Show a clear control when the field has text.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Input placeholder.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable the field.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Mark the field invalid for styling and aria-invalid.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled list open state.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Uncontrolled initial open state.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the list open state changes.

props.name: debounceMs
props.description: Debounce for async loadOptions.

props.name: id
props.description: Id on the text input.

props.name: emptyContent
props.description: Content when the filtered list is empty.

props.name: itemChrome
props.description: Default List Item chrome for every option row.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when no aria-labelledby is set.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Id of an external label. When set, aria-label is omitted so the external name wins.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional styles on the root.
